hook: One problem, solved in many programming styles

beats.say: Cristina Videira Lopes wrote Exercises in Programming Style, solving one problem, finding word frequencies in a text, in many different styles.
This article starts with the monolithic style: one long continuous block of code, with no division into functions or procedures.
The author teaches new computer science majors in C++, and uses these styles to show why functions make programs easier to read and debug.
